messages:
Maya: Quick kickoff for Cormorant-13B onboarding. Need a focused perf smoke and a small quant plan this week so we can decide whether to include in dedicated pool.

Liam: I can run perf. Env = dev-dedicated (gpu-small). Baseline plan: seq lenses 128 / 512 / 2048, batch sizes 1 / 4 / 16, streaming vs non-streaming. Will collect p50 / p95 / p99 and tokens/sec. Do we have hard SLOs?

Maya: Soft targets: p95 < 120ms at batch=1 seq=512 for prod-ish variant. Throughput > 180 tok/s at batch=16 seq=512. These are for quick gating vs our existing 13B profiles.

Sophia: I'll handle quantization probes. Proposed order: int8 static (weight-only), int8 dynamic (activation-aware), then an int4 probe if int8 looks promising. I will run perf + quick quality checks for each.

Raj: I'll spin up the quality regression suite. Using the "prod-chat-100" promptset + ~50 generative-safety checks. Metrics: EM where applicable, NLI-BERT score, simple hallucination heuristics. If auto signals look noisy I'll pull a 30-sample human review.

Liam: Small question -- canonical model path and variant names? Need to pin checkpoints for runs.

Sophia: We have weights at gs://redwood-models/cormorant-13b/v1.0/ (float32). Quant recipes under quant-recipe/cormorant/v1-int8.yaml. I'll tag artifacts with recipe and commit.

Maya: Also add a KV-cache warmup probe: cold vs warm start. Run a 1000-token warm sequence to measure cache-fill penalty. Add ctx sweep: 512 / 1024 / 2048 / 4096 to see scaling.

Liam: Will include warmup probe and measure per-request overhead for cache fill. Also include batching profiles with continuous batching ON and OFF to see end-to-end p95 impact.

Sophia: I'll produce an accuracy-vs-performance matrix for int8 static vs dynamic. If dynamic drops >2% on NLI-BERT or EM we mark it a quality risk and halt further quant escalation.

perf-bot: perf job created — id=8921, queued on cluster dev-dedicated-3. Link: https://ci.redwood/perf/8921 :hourglass_flowing_sand:

Raj: Prioritization suggestion: 1) baseline float32 perf smoke + cold/warm, 2) int8 static perf + qual, 3) int8 dynamic perf + qual, 4) ctx / batch sweeps on preferred quant variant. If float32 fails SLOs we deprioritize onboarding.

Maya: Action items:
- Liam: baseline float32 smoke + cold/warm + ctx sweep (due EOD Wed)
- Sophia: int8 static perf + qual (start Wed, report Thu AM)
- Raj: fire quality suites as results land and prepare human sample plan if auto signals >1.5% regression

Liam: Kicking off baseline now. Will post raw perf gist + 1-slide summary when done.

Sophia: Parallelizing quant runs to reduce turnaround. Will tag with job ids and attach recipe file used.

Maya: Great. We'll triage in Thu sync if anything is near threshold. Ping me for blockers. :thumbsup:
